_: The square's own life in a market town (town_life.gd _square_life; art target docs/art/target/town-composition/town-b: a square packed with shoppers, porters, children, dogs, a crier, guards and beggars, each there for a reason). on: the switch (--crowd=off). min_size: towns this big or bigger get it, and the crown's seat always. Each row: how many by the town's state (works.json priority; base, then the first state the town is in). crier: a crier at the well on a market day (his post crier: news, calls, the day's prices). beggars: at the church step (post beg; more in hunger). patrol: guards walking the square's ring in a pair, stopping to look about (pause seconds, pace world units a second, ring as a share of the square's radius; more in war). dogs: town dogs (the Quaternius wolf, shrunk to a dog's length in metres and tinted a hound's brown) trotting after people, sniffing and lying about (trot pace, follow: how near they keep). chase: pairs of children chasing each other round the square (run pace, how far apart before the chaser turns back). gossip: knots of townsfolk talking, who turn to look at news (post gossip; knot size [fewest, most]).
